Name: Sensible Item Colors
Description:
This mod changes the [b]internal color data[/b] of some vanilla items, to make sure that artisan products made from them follow more [b]real-world colors[/b].

It [b]does not[/b] change the visual appearance of any sprites. It does not change other mod's items.

Some examples:
- Blackberry Wine is now dark red instead of dark blue
- Coconut Jelly is now white instead of brown
- Dried Apple is now yellow instead of red
- Pickled Potato is now sandy instead of brown

It also [b]varies[/b] the color data of items so that artisan products don't look so similar. Rather than every vegetable being "green", some are now "yellow green", "sea green", "dark green", "jade", etc following their sprite, to try and make pickles and juices look not so identical.

It also changes the color data for [b]fish[/b] according to the color of their meat rather than their outsides. If you have any mods that add new colored artisan products for fish, such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24842]Cornucopia - Artisan Machines[/url], the color of the product will become more realistic.
- This has a side effect of changing the color of Roe, since Roe color follows the color of the fish.

Artisan Goods that already exist in your save will not change colors. But any new artisan goods will be created using the updated colors. (Keep in mind that old and new items may stack together.)

If you take any items to Emily's dye pots, they will also use the updated colors :)
